metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy stretch that may end in a satisfying self-pop, crack, or release in the neck.

It will focus on releasing upper trapezius muscle tightness, a leading cause of stiffness in the neck. 

Let us know how it works for you!

***************************
